name: Seabreams & sparids
description: Seabreams and sparids - sea breams, dentexes, pandoras and salemas (adults and juveniles measured as separate stanzas by the source for the seabreams and sparids groups). Functional group pooling the source's seabreams-adult, seabreams-juvenile, sparids-adult and sparids-juvenile compartments - the sparid guild grazing algae and picking benthic invertebrates, one of the lightly exploited groups in the fishery; pooled to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
